name: jeremy-riven-heronless
description: Riven lists built from Jeremy's own cards for his BO3 match (no Astral Heron, no Zhonya's Hourglass, one Blitzcrank), against the meta, with the Sacramento list (3 Herons, 3 Zhonya's) as the reference. Riven is piloted by its specialist, each opponent by its legend's specialist (Orianna by the general net).
